session_summary: Deep audit of _generate_synthesis and achievements system. Designed and deployed three-tier interest + media system (fresh/mentioned/confirmed). Cleaned up dead achievements[] array from workspace templates.

completed_this_session.details: fresh(15, FIFO) / mentioned(10, decay 15d) / confirmed(10, swap). LLM only names what it sees in dialog. All transitions deterministic code. Backward compat: old string format auto-normalized, missing 'fresh' key auto-initialized.

Same fresh/mentioned/confirmed logic applied to media. type field (film/series/book/etc) preserved through tier transitions. Fixed self-reinforcing loop: LLM was refreshing last_seen on items it saw in prompt without real dialog mention.

completed_this_session.what: Remove dead achievements[] array from workspace templates
completed_this_session.details: Removed from onboarding, cmd_leave, cmd_delete_all. New gardeners get clean workspace. Core system (achievements_count + sphere_history) unchanged and working correctly.

interest_tiers.fresh: 15 slots. FIFO by last_seen. count irrelevant for eviction. Promoted when count >= 2.
interest_tiers.mentioned: 10 slots. Decay 15 days → fresh, count=0. Promoted to confirmed via swap.
interest_tiers.confirmed: 10 slots. Static unless swap. Only entry: swap with strongest mentioned. Exit: swap → fresh, count=0.
interest_tiers.swap_logic: strongest mentioned vs weakest confirmed by (count, last_seen DESC). Loser → fresh, count=0.
interest_tiers.llm_role: LLM names confirmed_interests (active in dialog) and mentioned_interests (vague). Code does all transitions.

key_architecture_knowledge.media_tiers: Identical logic to interests. 15/10/10. type field preserved.
key_architecture_knowledge.achievements_system: achievements_count (counter, never resets) + sphere_history (monthly aggregates in deep_profile, 12-month rolling). achievements[] array is dead legacy — existing users keep it, new users don't get it.
key_architecture_knowledge.synthesis_trigger: Reactive: every 2 sr_observations via _add_sr_observation. Also forced at 21:00 in _send_daily_report for active gardeners.
key_architecture_knowledge.synthesis_save: Dual write: profile.deep_profile.memory (source of truth) + workspace.deep_memory (RAM cache for fast scheduler access). synthesis_date only in profile — ws branch in send_morning_greeting always falls back to profile.
key_architecture_knowledge.ram_github: All data loaded to RAM on startup (_store). GitHub sync every 2 minutes. GitHub is archive, RAM is working storage.
